items.raw_excerpt: Norway's capital Oslo, said Thursday it had banned smart glasses in schools, saying the move was aimed at preventing children from becoming "extras in Meta's data collection".

items.raw_excerpt: When you rent an apartment or buy a property in Switzerland, you will have to announce your arrival at your local municipality or commune. Here’s how to do this.
items.summary_en: In Switzerland, you must register your address with your local municipality when you move into a new apartment or house. You announce your arrival at the local commune office. This guide explains the steps.

items.raw_excerpt: The Dutch food and product safety authority NVWA is taking enforcement action against four Irish livestock transporters over the treatment of very young calves shipped to the Netherlands, broadcaster NOS reported on Thursday. The calves are given almost nothing to drink during a journey of at least 50 hours, which breaches EU animal welfare rules, the NVWA said. items.summary_en: Young calves shipped from Ireland to the Netherlands get almost nothing to drink during a journey of at least 50 hours. The Dutch food and product safety authority NVWA says this breaks EU animal welfare rules. Four Irish transporters have one year to change their methods or face financial penalties.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드에서 네덜란드로 실려 온 어린 송아지들이 최소 50시간 동안 거의 아무것도 마시지 못한 채 수송되었다. 네덜란드 식품안전당국(NVWA)은 이는 유럽연합 동물복지 규정을 어긴 것이라며 아일랜드 운송업체 네 곳에 제재 조치를 취했다. 업체들은 일 년 안에 일하는 방식을 바꾸지 않으면 금전적 벌칙을 받게 된다.

items.raw_excerpt: CPI urges Tamil Nadu government to abandon Pattinapakkam site for the new Secretariat plan, citing threats to fisherfolk, marine life, and climate safety.
items.summary_en: The CPI has asked the Tamil Nadu government to cancel its plan to build a new Secretariat in Pattinapakkam, Chennai. The party says the site threatens local fisherfolk and marine life. It also warns that the project could be risky for the climate.
